Package com.bupt.ta.model

Class MoProcessedReviewContext

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.model.MoProcessedReviewContext
public class MoProcessedReviewContext extends Object
Context for module-organiser (MO) retrospective AI review of a processed application.

Built at request time by ProcessedDecisionReviewService.buildContext(com.bupt.ta.model.Application, com.bupt.ta.model.Job, com.bupt.ta.model.ApplicantProfile, java.lang.String) when an MO views an Accepted, Rejected, or Withdrawn application on the MO dashboard. Not persisted — fields are copied from Application, optional Job, and ApplicantProfile for LM prompt construction.

Not thread-safe: plain public fields for servlet request scope only.

See Also:

  • AiFeatureNames.DECISION_REVIEW
